tldr: Admins can now send invitations to staged members, from a row action or the invite dialog. A staged member becomes invited and keeps the role, collections and groups it was provisioned with.
goal: Let an organization create members ahead of time, then invite them when it is ready, without setting their access again.

story.heading: POST send-invite added for staged members
story.body: The members grid row action sends a list of member ids. The response gives 1 result per id, so a bad id does not fail the request.

story.heading: InviteStagedOrganizationUsersCommand added
story.body: It keeps only staged members of the organization, reserves seats once for all of them, moves them to invited and emails them.

story.heading: Seats are reserved first and released on failure
story.body: Password Manager seats come before Secrets Manager seats. When an email fails, the members go back to staged and the command releases both reservations.

story.heading: The invite dialog now promotes staged members
story.body: An invite by email that matches a staged member updates that member. It keeps its Id and ExternalId, which SCIM and Directory Connector use.

story.heading: The whole change
story.body: The API calls a single Admin Console command. Admin Console asks Billing about the Secrets Manager discount, and both adapters implement the new read.

components.summary: New POST send-invite endpoint returns 1 result per member id.
New command invites staged members with their provisioned access; the invite dialog promotes a staged match by email.
New GetManyByOrganizationEmailsAsync reads the members of an organization by email.
New OrganizationUser_ReadManyByOrganizationIdEmails stored procedure and its migration script.

decisions.title: Skip bad ids, report them one at a time
decisions.why: A member that is missing, in another organization or no longer staged gets its own error. The other members still get their invitation.
decisions.alternative: Fail the whole request on the first bad id.

decisions.title: Reserve seats once for the whole set
decisions.why: Seat expansion is all or nothing. A single reservation covers every eligible member, and a failure leaves no seat paid for.
decisions.alternative: Reserve 1 seat per member as each invitation goes out.

decisions.title: Undo the status when an email fails
decisions.why: The command moves the members back to staged and the caller releases both seat reservations. No member stays invited without an email.
decisions.alternative: Send the emails first and change the status afterwards.

decisions.title: Promote the staged row, do not create a new one
decisions.why: SCIM and Directory Connector find members by Id and ExternalId. The invite dialog keeps both and overwrites only the fields the invite sets.
decisions.alternative: Delete the staged row and insert an invited member.

decisions.title: A new bulk read on the repository port
decisions.why: The invite dialog matches many emails at once. Both adapters implement it, so SQL Server and the EF databases behave the same.
